description: Static QDQ ablation on the full 1,370-image validation split, 640 px input, MinMax calibration on 256 training frames, per-channel weights.

rows.note: The final Concat mixes box pixels (0..682) with probabilities (0..1). One scale over that tensor steps by 2.7, so every score below 0.5 dequantizes to 0 and the model returns no detections.
Detections come back, but quantizing the Detect head still costs 13 mAP. Percentile calibration instead of MinMax recovers only 1.6 of it (40.66).

rows.recipe: Output Concat + Detect head in float (shipped)
rows.note: Backbone and neck stay INT8; the head's DFL box regression and score branch keep float precision. Costs 1.2 MB and 3 ms against the fully quantized graph.
